## What changes?

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if one exists.

## How was it verified?

List the checks you ran and their results. For a recipe, identify its reviewed template and give reproducible input/expected behavior. For runtime work, include relevant device/model checks and limitations.

## Review checklist

- [ ] The change is focused, and its capabilities and limits are described accurately.
- [ ] Relevant validation passes (`npm test`, `npm run verify`, and validation of any changed example manifest); unperformed checks are explained above.
- [ ] Matching declarations, schemas and documentation are updated where needed.
- [ ] Contributions and included assets can be shared under the applicable licenses; required third-party notices are retained.
- [ ] The diff contains no secrets, private material, generated model/output caches or proprietary Studio code.

Source review does not automatically publish to npm, install an agent in Studio or create a community catalog listing.
